note: City of Center (Oliver County) RV park on a residential block in town: a gravel lot of full-hookup spaces with no campground amenities beyond the hookups. The city prices it for long stays, and imagery shows it nearly full of travel trailers. The town's dump station is at the civic center on ND-48. --Claude
summary: City page: 20 full-hookup spaces, $50 nightly / $150 weekly / $450 monthly, reservations highly recommended, phone now (701) 794-3650. Imagery: ~18 trailers filling the lot on a residential block - long-stay/workforce use. Groups written; LONG-STAY DROP CANDIDATE flagged. Pin ok. Lead: Ball Park RV Park.
flags: LONG-STAY / WORKFORCE (drop candidate, for AWH): the city's only price list makes a night cost $50 against $150 for a whole week and $450 a month ('Rent is $450/month, $150/weekly, or $50/nightly.' - 'Rent' is the city's word), so a night is priced at more than two days of the weekly rate - nightly use reads as an afterthought. On Esri imagery the lot (47.1135,-101.2950) holds ~18 travel trailers/fifth wheels in rows, essentially full, on a residential block; Center is the town beside the Milton R. Young power station and the Center lignite mine. No Google listing of its own and no reviews found (The Dyrt shows one review, not read). Nightly rate IS posted (test 2 passes) and there is no discouraging wording; the nightly share is not stated. I read it as a mostly long-term park.
PHONE: stored 701-794-3502 is the City of Center office (the page now gives it for the Ball Park RV Park); the City RV Park's own line on the page is (701) 794-3650.
ADDRESS: the page gives 304 Square Butte St E; HHS lists 304 Square Butte St SE.
PIN: stored 47.11334,-101.29515 sits on the street just south of the RV lot (~30 m): ok.
HOOKUPS: amperage not stated; electric left absent.
